formCues: Land softly on the same leg
setup: Stand on one leg facing a sturdy plyo box a comfortable jump distance away.
commonMistakes: Landing with a stiff knee
Using the trail leg to assist takeoff
Box too high for control

formCues: Keep extended leg in line with torso
setup: Lie supine with one foot flat on the floor, knee bent, and the other leg extended straight up.
commonMistakes: Letting hips dip on the extended-leg side
Overarching the lower back
Pushing through the toes instead of the heel

formCues: Land balanced on the same foot
Absorb landing through hip and knee
setup: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend, arms back, ready to jump forward for distance.
commonMistakes: Jumping before fully loading the hip
Landing off-balance
Switching feet mid-air

formCues: Hinge at the hip, not the waist
Extend free leg behind for counterbalance
Keep slight bend in standing knee
setup: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell across the chest or at the shoulders.
commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back
Losing balance and touching down early
Hinging from the knees instead of hips

setup: Sit with upper back against a bench, dumbbell on the hip crease, one foot planted and the other leg extended.
commonMistakes: Hyperextending the lower back at the top
Letting hips rotate open
Pushing through the toes

formCues: Hinge hips back as torso lowers
setup: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand, slight bend in the standing knee.
commonMistakes: Rounding the spine
Twisting the hips open
Bending the standing knee too much, turning it into a squat

formCues: Rise fully onto the ball of the foot
setup: Stand on one foot on a raised platform holding a dumbbell, heel free to drop below the edge.
commonMistakes: Bouncing instead of controlling the descent
Using momentum from the hip
Cutting the range of motion short

formCues: Extend knee fully without locking hard
setup: Sit on a leg extension machine with the pad against one shin, hands gripping the side handles.
commonMistakes: Swinging the weight with momentum
Not controlling the lowering phase
Hyperextending the knee at the top

formCues: Pull shoulder blades down and back
Extend one leg while tucking the other
setup: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, then pull the body to horizontal with one leg extended.
commonMistakes: Sagging hips below shoulder line
Losing scapular engagement
Rushing into the hold without a progression

setup: Lie supine with one knee bent and foot flat, the other leg extended straight.
commonMistakes: Letting the hips tilt toward the extended leg
Arching the lower back excessively
Using the extended leg to push off

formCues: Squeeze glute hard at the top
setup: Lie with upper back on a bench, one foot planted flat, the other leg extended straight out.
commonMistakes: Overextending the lower back at lockout
Letting hips rotate off-square
Not reaching full hip extension

formCues: Stay light on the ball of the foot
setup: Stand balanced on one leg with a slight knee bend, ready to hop in place.
commonMistakes: Landing flat-footed with a stiff ankle
Losing balance between hops
Overstriding instead of staying compact

formCues: Load hip and knee before pushing off
Land softly and stick the landing
Absorb through hip, knee, and ankle
setup: Stand on one leg, hip and knee slightly flexed, aiming to hop forward as far as possible.
commonMistakes: Landing stiff-legged
Failing to stick the landing without a hop
Rushing the takeoff without loading

formCues: Drive knee up over each hurdle
setup: Stand on one leg facing a series of low hurdles spaced for consecutive hops.
commonMistakes: Clipping hurdles from insufficient knee drive
Excessive ground contact time
Leaning too far forward

formCues: Keep kettlebell close to the shin
Extend free leg behind for balance
setup: Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell in the opposite hand, feet hip-width under the torso.
commonMistakes: Rounding the back at the bottom
Losing balance mid-rep
Turning it into a squat by bending the knee too much

formCues: Push off explosively to the side
Land softly with a bent knee
setup: Stand balanced on one leg, ready to hop laterally over a line or marker.
commonMistakes: Landing with a straight, locked knee
Losing lateral balance on landing
Hopping too far for current control level

formCues: Press through the ball of the foot
Extend ankle fully at the top
setup: Sit in the leg press machine with the ball of one foot on the lower edge of the platform.
commonMistakes: Bouncing through the bottom of the range
Bending the knee to assist the press
Cutting range of motion short

formCues: Keep hips pressed into the pad
Avoid hips lifting off the pad
setup: Lie face down on a leg curl machine with the pad positioned above one heel.
commonMistakes: Lifting hips off the pad to generate momentum
Using a jerky, fast tempo
Not achieving full contraction at the top

formCues: Keep knee mostly stiff, drive from the ankle
Land on the ball of the foot
setup: Stand balanced on one leg with a slight forward lean, ready to hop repeatedly using the ankle.
commonMistakes: Bending the knee excessively, turning it into a squat hop
Landing flat-footed
Slouching the torso forward

formCues: Place foot centered on the platform
Avoid locking the knee out hard
setup: Sit in the leg press machine with one foot on the platform, the other resting off to the side.
commonMistakes: Letting the knee cave inward
Using excessive range that rounds the lower back
Locking the knee out aggressively

formCues: Press through the ball of the foot
Rise fully, pause at the top
Lower heel below the platform edge
setup: Sit at the calf raise machine with the pad over one knee and the ball of that foot on the platform.
commonMistakes: Bouncing at the bottom of the stretch
Rushing the tempo
Not achieving a full stretch at the bottom

formCues: Keep thigh pressed to the seat pad
setup: Sit in the leg curl machine with the ankle pad behind one ankle and thigh secured under the leg pad.
commonMistakes: Using momentum instead of a controlled curl
Not securing the thigh pad, letting the hip rise
Partial range of motion

formCues: Curl heel toward glute by flexing the knee
setup: Lie supine with one heel on a slider and hips lifted into a bridge, the other leg extended or off the ground.
commonMistakes: Letting hips sag during the curl
Sliding too fast without control
Losing the bridge position

formCues: Position bar across the upper back
Rise fully onto the ball of the foot
Lower heel below the step edge
setup: Stand on one foot on a raised platform under a Smith machine bar racked across the shoulders.
commonMistakes: Using knee bend to cheat the range
Bouncing at the bottom
Shifting weight onto the non-working leg

formCues: Roll ball toward glutes using the heel
Brace core to prevent hip sag
setup: Lie supine with one heel on a stability ball, hips lifted, and the other leg extended in the air.
commonMistakes: Letting hips drop during the movement
Losing ball control from insufficient bracing
Rushing the tempo

formCues: Control the strap on the return
setup: Lie supine with one heel in the TRX straps, hips raised, and the other leg extended off the ground.
commonMistakes: Letting hips sag mid-rep
Allowing the working foot to slide off-center
Rushing the eccentric phase

formCues: Land softly with a bent knee
setup: Stand balanced on one leg with a slight knee bend, ready to hop straight upward.
commonMistakes: Landing with a stiff, locked knee
Losing balance on landing
Excessive forward lean during the hop

formCues: Lean back as knees travel forward
setup: Position the shins against the pads of the sissy squat machine, hips locked in place, hands on the handles.
commonMistakes: Bending at the hips instead of isolating the knees
Rushing the eccentric
Using momentum to bounce out of the bottom

setup: Lie supine with knees bent, feet flat, and hands crossed on the chest or lightly behind the head.
commonMistakes: Yanking the neck with the hands
Using momentum instead of ab strength
Not controlling the descent

formCues: Hinge at the hips as you pull down
setup: Stand facing the ski erg machine, gripping a handle in each hand at shoulder height.
commonMistakes: Pulling only with the arms, no hip hinge
Rounding the back excessively
Rushing the recovery phase

setup: Hang from gymnastic rings or a bar with an overhand grip, arms straight and core engaged.
commonMistakes: Rushing the rotation and losing control
Swinging with momentum instead of strength
Overextending the shoulders past a safe range

formCues: Drive through the legs, not the arms
setup: Attach a harness or strap to a loaded sled and face it, walking backward to drag it.
commonMistakes: Standing too upright, losing leg drive
Taking overly long strides
Letting the strap go slack between steps

setup: Attach straps from a loaded sled to a harness or hands and walk forward, pulling it behind you.
commonMistakes: Standing too upright
Taking choppy, inconsistent steps
Letting the sled jerk instead of a steady pull

formCues: Keep arms extended at handle height
Drive through the balls of the feet
setup: Stand behind the sled gripping the high handles at chest to shoulder height, body angled forward.
commonMistakes: Leaning too far forward and losing power
Taking short, choppy steps
Letting arms bend and absorb the push

formCues: Set a low body angle, hips down
setup: Stand behind the sled gripping the low handles, body angled forward closer to the ground.
commonMistakes: Rounding the back instead of hinging
Standing too tall for the low handle position
Short, ineffective steps

formCues: Curl both heels toward glutes together
setup: Lie supine with both heels on sliders and hips lifted into a bridge position.
commonMistakes: Letting hips drop mid-rep
Sliding out too fast without control
Not achieving full hip extension

formCues: Drive bar up in a straight line
setup: Lie on a bench under the Smith machine bar with feet flat and grip slightly wider than shoulders.
commonMistakes: Flaring elbows out too wide
Bouncing the bar off the chest
Feet sliding out of position during the press

formCues: Hinge forward with a flat back
Pull bar toward the lower ribs
Squeeze shoulder blades at the top
setup: Stand under the Smith machine bar, hinge at the hips to roughly 45 degrees, and grip the bar shoulder-width.
commonMistakes: Rounding the back during the pull
Using momentum from the legs to jerk the bar up
Not achieving full scapular retraction

formCues: Lower until rear knee nearly grazes the floor
Keep front knee tracking over toes
setup: Position the bar across the upper back, place one foot behind you on a bench, front foot forward and stable.
commonMistakes: Letting the front knee cave inward
Placing the front foot too close, limiting depth
Leaning too far forward

formCues: Keep elbows tucked close to the body
Lower bar to the lower chest
Press up in a straight line
setup: Lie on a bench under the Smith machine bar with a close, shoulder-width or narrower grip.
commonMistakes: Flaring elbows out wide
Gripping too narrow and straining the wrists
Bouncing the bar off the chest
